text: The Group's securitization program (for a maximum of 200 million) is the only significant line of variable-rate finance. [#6028](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6028)

Commercial paper (NEU CP) On the short-term capital market, Elis has an unrated commercial paper program (NEU CP), approved by Banque de France, for a maximum amount of 600.0 million. [#6445](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6445)

Commercial paper (NEU CP) On the short-term capital markets, Elis has a commercial paper program (NEU CP), rated Prime-3 by Moody's since April 10, 2025, approved by Banque de France, for a maximum amount of 600.0 million. [#6097](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6097)

Medium-term negotiable notes (NEU MTN) In addition to its commercial paper program, since June 2021 Elis has also had a program of unrated medium-term negotiable notes (NEU MTN), approved by the Banque de France, for a maximum amount of 200.0 million. Medium-term negotiable notes (NEU MTN) In addition to its commercial paper program, since June 2021 Elis has also had a program of medium-term negotiable notes (NEU MTN), rated Prime-3 by Moody's since April 10, 2025, approved by the Banque de France, for a maximum amount of 200.0 million. [#6094](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6094)

Recent refinancing (EMTN in March 2024 and September 2025), at interest rates higher than those of previous lines of funding, is offset by the decrease in short-term rates on commercial paper and the securitization program. [#6058](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6058)

Through this syndicated credit facility agreement, the Group has, as at December 31, 2025, an undrawn confirmed credit facility of 900.0 million, thus ensuring the necessary liquidity for the Group for its commercial paper program in the event the commercial paper market closes. [#6449](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6449)
